collisionMap.verification: All 4 appliance scripts confirmed absent at commit 504405b9. Downstream cards own their respective script authoring.

decision8.title: Relationship to ADR-12 — appliance is a superset, remote-tenant is one of its modes
decision8.directive: APPLIANCE_MODE=hub|attached selects mode. hub runs local issuers/ingest; attached renders signalloom-warden-overlays/remote-tenant and consumes central issuer secrets. ADR-12 is not superseded; no separate product line is permitted.

decision9.title: Release trust by digest pin plus bundle-time signing
decision9.directive: Platform images are pinned by immutable digest and signed at bundle time with SLSI release key; no separate release signing pipeline. Release private key stays in OpenBao transit KMS; appliance ships only public key. Tag-only references are forbidden.
